aliases: CyrusOne 2725 Bilter Road data center campus
C1 Chicago Aurora III LLC / 2725 Bilter Road

location.location_note: Expansion campus site is south of Bilter Road, west of Eola Road, and north of Interstate 88; prior seed county was Kane, but public records for 2725 Bilter Road place the site in DuPage County.

actions.action_type: PDD amendment, conditional use, and preliminary plan/plat approvals
actions.notes: Approved 2725 Bilter Road data center campus entitlements for C1 Chicago Aurora III LLC, including a data-center-only warehouse/distribution/storage use, telecommunications facilities, and preliminary plan/plat.

actions.government_body: City of Aurora Committee of the Whole
actions.notes: Final plan approved for Lots 1-5 of Butterfield Phase II Subdivision, Unit 5B at 2725 Bilter Road for a data center campus. City staff described three construction phases: a 411,175 sq ft first building with generator yards and two towers; a utility substation; and a future approximately 153,000 sq ft building.
Governor's office and CyrusOne reported a groundbreaking for a new Aurora campus with two buildings totaling 446,000 sq ft; CyrusOne reported 40 MW initial IT capacity.
City established dormant SSA 228 for stormwater management at 2725 Bilter Road; staff described the SSA as a prerequisite for stormwater permit issuance.

capacity_note: 40 MW is the initial IT capacity publicly announced for the 2024 2725 Bilter Road expansion campus. CyrusOne separately advertises 109 MW for the existing Aurora CHI1-CHI3 campus; that is not used as this expansion record's capacity.
owner: CyrusOne; land-use applicant/entity: C1 Chicago Aurora III LLC
